## Delivery handoff — Coach Core merge eligibility aggregate (draft PR #77) — Codex independent review requested

**Delivery, not independent acceptance. No merge/deploy/protection/runtime changes. MVP remains NO-GO.**

**Base:** `efc9116cf93c5d235b0b2edeb4d7be03a4e73cdc` (PR #75 head: accepted B11 `f2e1fed` + B15 `ffb4045`; runtime `518e9e5`). **Head:** `dbf7a9ae7dd51092f9ec2ac86f3c19a0d67b23f4`. PR base branch = `codex/integrate-b11-b15-2026-10-17`, so the diff is this slice only.
**Changed-file scope (5):** `.github/workflows/e2e-emulator.yml`, `e2e/package.json` (`test:gate`), `e2e/scripts/merge-eligibility.mjs` (new), `e2e/scripts/merge-eligibility.test.mjs` (new), `docs/security/MERGE_ELIGIBILITY_GATE_2026-10-17.md` (new). App code, browser tests, config, reporter, evidence script/checks: byte-identical to PR #75. The only change inside the e2e jobs is a `run.context` provenance file (printf %s from env; inventoried/hashed by B15).

### Aggregate rules (job `merge-eligibility`, check `Coach Core merge eligibility`, `needs: e2e`, `if: always() && !cancelled()`, read-only token)
| | Requirement |
|---|---|
| R1 | event ∈ {`pull_request`, `merge_group`}; `workflow_dispatch`/`push` can never satisfy it |
| R2 | all 12 expected jobs present exactly once and completed; 4 acceptance jobs `success`; diagnostic/obsolete may be success **or failure** (visible, non-blocking — approved classification) but cancelled/skipped/in-progress/missing/duplicate blocks |
| R3 | every job's artifact present with `UPLOAD_OK`, `INVENTORY.sha256` re-verified against retained bytes on the runner |
| R4 | `run.context` binds to this sha, head sha, run id, **attempt**, event, project/bucket, repeat 1 |
| R5 | executed identities == **source-derived `--list` membership** of the judged checkout (no hard-coded counts; 65/10/1 desktop, 15/0/0 phone today). Any grep/project/bucket narrowing fails. Zero executions pass only when membership is empty and `results.json` has zero tests — reported as "legitimately empty: 0 selected, 0 executed, 0 passed", never as passes |
| R6 | acceptance: every test `expected`, `results.length == 1`, every result `passed`; no skipped/interrupted/timedOut; `errors[]` empty; `.last-run` passed |
| R7 | skipped on cancelled runs; fails closed if the API, download or `--list` cannot be gathered |
Output: step-summary table (job/conclusion/artifact/selected/executed/passed/failed/verdict), `::notice`/`::error`, artifact `merge-eligibility-<sha>`.

### Triggers
`pull_request` → recovery now includes `ready_for_review`; `merge_group: checks_requested` declared — **applies only if the owner enables a merge queue (none exists today)**; push/dispatch unchanged (matrix still runs for evidence; the aggregate is INELIGIBLE on them by design). Concurrency unchanged; cancellation skips the aggregate. Not added: a trigger for PRs into the frozen harness branch (would start full matrices for stacked PRs — owner decision).

### Focused validation
`node e2e/scripts/merge-eligibility.test.mjs` → **14/14**: complete success (pull_request & merge_group), one failed required job, failing acceptance tests under a green job, cancelled required / cancelled non-required, skipped, in-progress, missing/duplicate job, missing artifact, no UPLOAD_OK, inventory mismatch, narrowed grep (recorded and unrecorded), legitimate empty vs zero-with-membership, wrong sha/run/attempt/head, artifacts named for another sha, repeat mismatch, run-level errors, on-disk artifact reader with tamper detection, workflow contract. Accepted suites still pass on this tree: reporter 10/10, evidence 19. **These are simulated fixtures, not Actions executions.**

### Actual Actions evidence (head `dbf7a9a`)
- **Cancellation:** the pre-existing `claude/**` push trigger auto-started full-matrix run [39079741112](https://github.com/DigitalBlueprint239/coach-core-ai/actions/runs/39079741112); the bounded dispatch below cancelled it via concurrency. All 12 e2e jobs **and the aggregate** concluded `cancelled` — no verdict left on the commit.
- **Bounded dispatch** [39079754536](https://github.com/DigitalBlueprint239/coach-core-ai/actions/runs/39079754536) (`D10-01|N2-D0|N2-A2`): 12/12 e2e jobs success; aggregate job: self-checks ✅ (14 on the runner), download-artifact ✅ (12), **Evaluate → INELIGIBLE by design**, report artifact uploaded (`sha256:675c68ef…005d82`). Verdict: `R1 event "workflow_dispatch" is not a trusted merge event | R5 … a dispatch grep narrowed the selection | R5 … executed identities != membership (missing 64, extra 0) | … +11 more` — 19 reasons, exactly R1 + the expected R5 set for this grep, and **no R2/R3/R4/R7 reasons**: the jobs API read, all 12 downloads, UPLOAD_OK, inventory re-verification and sha/run/attempt binding passed on real artifacts.
- **Limitation:** no actual `pull_request` ELIGIBLE verdict exists. It needs a PR into recovery (full matrix) and a green acceptance bucket, which runtime `518e9e5` cannot give (D10-08a) — a dependency on Codex's runtime/import candidate; this gate does not carve D10-08a out. Dispatch-run ZIPs were not opened from my workspace; the aggregate's on-runner verification is the evidence.

### Enforcement proposal (documentation only — nothing changed)
Target `recovery/coach-core-mvp-2026` (observed `3992d8d`, unprotected, rulesets 0). Require **exactly one** status check: `Coach Core merge eligibility` (GitHub Actions app). Do **not** require the four `E2E acceptance (*)` names. Enable only after PR #75 and this slice are merged into recovery (otherwise every PR waits on a context that never appears). Consider "require branches up to date" or a merge queue (then `merge_group` applies), and ≥1 approving review; no routine bypass. Known limitation: re-running jobs in the same run collides with `upload-artifact@v4` names (pre-existing B15 behaviour) and R4 rejects other attempts — push a new commit instead.

### Dependencies
PR #75 merge and its sequencing onto recovery; Codex's PR #72 + default-off import + runtime candidate for a green acceptance bucket; owner decisions on the harness-target trigger and the settings above.

### Codex review checklist
1. Diff vs `efc9116` is the 5 files above; accepted files byte-identical. 2. The only e2e-job change is the `run.context` write. 3. Run the 14 fixtures; add your own `evaluate()` probes (membership drift, extra project, attempt mismatch). 4. Confirm R1 blocks dispatch/push and `!cancelled()` skips on cancel (run 39079741112). 5. Inspect run 39079754536's aggregate summary/artifact. 6. Confirm `permissions` read-only, no secrets in output. 7. Judge triggers and the proposal against the intended target/queue use.

Evidence 72: `docs/evidence/cc-acceptance-2026-10-14/72-merge-eligibility-gate-delivery-dbf7a9a.txt` (commit `1d12173`).
